question: Which divine figures preside at Gomanta and at Kāśī?
premises: Gomante names the first sacred site.
Vāyanaś is the presiding figure there.
Kāśyāṃ names the second sacred site.
Viśveśvarāhvayaḥ names the presiding figure there.
inference: Vāyana presides at Gomanta and the one called Viśveśvara presides at Kāśī.
plain_english: At Gomanta is Vāyana, and at Kāśī is the one called Viśveśvara.
